qualifies the following noun as genuine or real

items.question: What kind of renown is affirmed as genuine fame here?
premises: The term sat denotes what is true or genuine.
The term kīrtiḥ denotes fame or renown.
The compound sat-kīrtiḥ qualifies fame as genuinely real.
items.inference: The renown indicated is not merely apparent but is affirmed as true fame.
uncertainties: The relation of this marker to the preceding doctrinal argument is not explicit in the verse itself.
